instruction: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.

arguments.note: The holder is on the right of the four pens. I approach its side with the right hand to keep its opening clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 137 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically.
